definition.en: The Human Poverty Index (HPI) is a composite index that measures the extent of deprivation in basic human development dimensions within a country.
definition.hi: The Human Poverty Index (HPI) is a composite index that measures the extent of deprivation in basic human development dimensions within a country.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding HPI is crucial for UPSC GS-3 as it provides a multidimensional perspective on poverty beyond mere income levels. It helps aspirants analyze social sector performance and policy effectiveness in the Indian economy.
importanceInUpsc.hi: Understanding HPI is crucial for UPSC GS-3 as it provides a multidimensional perspective on poverty beyond mere income levels. It helps aspirants analyze social sector performance and policy effectiveness in the Indian economy.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the shift from income-based poverty to multidimensional deprivation.
learningOutcomes.hi: Understand the shift from income-based poverty to multidimensional deprivation.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the indicators used to assess human development and poverty.
